### Pull Request Motivation

If you delete a Certificate resource with ["foreground" cascading deletion](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/architecture/garbage-collection/#foreground-deletion), the child objects such as the Secret and the CertificateRequest objects will be deleted first. This causes the Certificate controllers to re-create these even though the Certificate resource is being deleted itself.
